name: Janus Corporation Limited
summary: Janus Corporation Limited (Janus Corp. Ltd.) primarily operates within the civil construction sector. Beyond its core construction activities, the company also encompasses divisions for Hospitality Support Services and the trading of agricultural products. Its construction services include comprehensive land and site development, land preparation (such as filling), the erection of fencing walls, and a variety of other related construction projects. Established on November 30, 1998, the company maintains its headquarters in Mumbai, India.
